hook: Recent analysis at the Musée de Cluny proves Nicolas Flamel was just a wealthy Parisian man.

sections.voiceover: Recent analysis at the Musée de Cluny proves Nicolas Flamel was just a wealthy Parisian man.
Musée de Cluny in Paris is finally revealing the historical truth about him. Where did this myth originate?
Except scholars now believe that testament was composed much later, in the 18th century.
Writers have maintained 600 years of fascination with the myth of Nicolas and Pernelle Flamel. The real man left behind records at the Musée de Cluny, not magical gold.
Visit the new exhibition in Paris starting October 13, 2026.
